summary: The daily recommendation skips a paper that has no abstract and no PDF: nothing stored on disk and no PDF source known (neither a direct PDF nor an open-access landing page). The paper stays in the project and still counts for the profile and the map. Applies with and without a learning map.

budget_impact.rationale: A local filter on the candidate pool; no model call, no network, no stored data change.
budget_impact.before: papers with nothing to read could be recommended
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: the new tests failed, then the filter was restored

open_risks: Read 'no PDF' as no PDF source at all: an open-access landing page still counts as readable.
How many papers of the owner's library this removes is unknown.
If every unseen paper is unreadable there is no batch.
